headline: Affordable finance access for tens of thousands more people
summary_en: The UK government announces reforms allowing credit union members to refer relatives for membership after moving away.
summary_zh: 英国政府宣布改革，允许搬离的信用社会员介绍亲属入会。
watch_en: Credit union members who move away from the area can refer their relatives for membership.
watch_zh: 搬离该地区的信用社会员可介绍亲属入会。
excerpt: Government announces further reforms to credit unions to allow members who move away from the area to refer their relatives for membership.
